rule: status=Accepted is insufficient; resolve supersession + amended_by
algorithm: If any later Accepted lists this id in supersedes → treat as superseded; follow that successor (even if status still Accepted)
If status Superseded → follow superseded_by (or reverse claimers)
If status Proposed/Deprecated/Rejected → not implement authority
If status Accepted → also load all amended_by Accepted peers; never apply bare parent when amends exist
If conflict among live peers → stop and amend/supersede edges
